clips.title: The story
paras: Night elf scouts have slipped out from Silverwing Outpost into Ashenvale. Kuray'bin calls for a strike against the Ashenvale Outrunners before they can report on Horde encampments and defenses.

Night elf scouts from Silverwing Outpost are moving through the woods east of their base and south of nearby Horde holdings. In Ashenvale's contested forest, they watch the paths and ridges, mapping fortifications and tracking troop movements. Kuray'bin has learned that these scouts, known as Ashenvale Outrunners, have slipped into the wilderness to gather intelligence.

The Horde strikes at enemy scouts before they can return to Silverwing Outpost. Hunting down the outrunners denies its commanders knowledge of Horde troop strength and outpost defenses. Without their forward eyes, the night elves are left disoriented and less willing to risk aggressive moves through the contested woods.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We received reports that Ashenvale outrunners left Silverwing Outpost not long ago, and now sneak near our territories in the forest. We don't want them gathering intelligence on our defenses!
Sneak through the forests south of our post here and east of the Alliance outpost of Silverwing. Find and slay the outrunners, then return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I await reports of your outrunner kills, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good, friend. Your hunting skills are impressive...
The loss of those outrunners helps blind the Alliance, and when they lack intelligence they are less likely to launch attacks.
